items.title: 3 ETFs For Owning Starbucks Without The Same Surrounding Risks
items.summary: You might like Starbucks for its brand and global reach, but buying the stock alone means carrying its specific issues by yourself. Simply Wall St flags that its dividend of 2.34% is not well covered by earnings, and it also highlights a high level of debt. Owning Starbucks inside a fund that holds many businesses limits how much those company specific risks can swing your portfolio, and also limits how much Starbucks can help it.
